#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int W, M;
    cin >> W >> M;

    vector<int> B(101, 0);
    int value = M;
    int carry = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
        int digit = value % W + carry;
        carry = 0;
        if (digit > 1) {
            digit -= W;
            carry = 1;
        }
        B[i] = digit;
        value /= W;
    }
    B[100] += carry;

    for (int i = 0; i <= 100; i++) {
        if (B[i] < -1 || B[i] > 1) {
            cout << "NO" << endl;
            return 0;
        }
    }
    cout << "YES" << endl;
    return 0;
}
